author: Arnav
problem: Given submission times in minutes, count how many came in after the deadline plus the grace period; submitting exactly at the end of the grace period is on time.
bug_description: Uses t >= cutoff instead of t > cutoff, so a submission exactly at the end of the grace period is counted late.

comments.accurate: Counts submissions after deadline + grace; the cutoff minute itself is on time
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts submissions at or after deadline + grace as late
comments.wrong_location: Late check verified; confirm grace is added to the deadline, not subtracted
